selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits only SSH and TCP/8080 with an explicit rejection fallback
selected_evidence.summary: Runtime and permanent public-zone configuration contains SSH and 8080/tcp with target REJECT; firewalld is active and enabled.

selected_evidence.requirement: Inbound SSH and TCP/8080 are allowed while unrelated inbound TCP is rejected
selected_evidence.summary: With live listeners present, isolated inbound probes connected to TCP/22 and TCP/8080, while TCP/9090 was rejected both before and after reboot.

The healthy pre-restart boot ID was fbdf5b2c-bb43-49f6-935d-fb98f8a972f6; the reboot was acknowledged; the recovered boot ID was 6336d797-27b6-427b-ac4b-019ad8304c88. Firewalld, sshd, the persisted policy, and expected filtering behavior all recovered.
No probe namespaces or temporary TCP/8080 or TCP/9090 listeners remain; only enp1s0 is assigned to the active public zone.

commands.command:
ip netns exec fwprobe python3 -c 'import socket
for port in (22, 8080, 9090):
    sock = socket.socket()
    sock.settimeout(2)
    try:
        sock.connect(("192.0.2.1", port))
        print("tcp/%d CONNECTED" % port)
    except OSError as exc:
        print("tcp/%d REJECTED error=%s errno=%s" % (port, type(exc).__name__, getattr(exc, "errno", None)))
    finally:
        sock.close()'
